en.hook: Two clocks off by a few milliseconds and my sensors swear the effect came first. A trace settles the argument.
en.mission: In `code/main.py` change `exchange(0.123, 0.03, 0.01)` to `exchange(0.123, 0.02, 0.02)`. Predict the offset estimate, then run `python3 code/main.py`.
